roleTitle: Trade Finance Operations Specialist, Documentary Credits
jobDescription: The trade finance operations desk processes the bank's documentary credits and collections for corporate clients. The Trade Finance Operations Specialist examines presented documents against the credit terms, prepares the discrepancy notices and the payment instructions for the checker's release, records the checker's decisions in the trade system, keeps the client status report current, and documents each transaction's open items. Release of payments stays with the checker under the four-eyes rule. Reports to the trade operations manager; works with the checkers, the relationship managers and the correspondent banks' trade desks.
requirements: Examines presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard.
Prepares discrepancy notices and payment instructions for the checker's release, with release staying with the checker.
Records the checker's decisions in the trade system and keeps the client status report current.
Coordinates document queries with the correspondent banks and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each transaction's open items and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Trade finance operations specialist at a commercial bank for four years, examining presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard for about six hundred presentations a year.

Prepared the discrepancy notices and the payment instructions for each presentation for the checker's release; the release was the checker's under the four-eyes rule, recorded against my preparation in the trade system.
Recorded the checkers' decisions in the trade system and kept the client status report current for the relationship managers each day.
Coordinated document queries with the correspondent banks' trade desks through the query log, recording which queries I closed and which were referred to the checker.
Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each transaction at day end for the next examiner.

Work sample: one anonymised presentation file (examination worksheet, discrepancy notice, payment instruction with the checker's release record) and one client status report, with the trade system's audit history as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former trade operations manager: confirmed the candidate examined presentations and prepared instructions in the period, that release stayed with the checkers, and confirmed the employment dates.
Panel note after the final interview: please lay the packet out by requirement with the evidence for each, so the panel can compare it with the examination standard before the debrief.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the examination work, the preparation and release boundary, the records, the query coordination and the hand-over notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the release boundary as documented: preparation by the candidate, release by the checker under the four-eyes rule; the packet lays out evidence by requirement and makes no judgement.
